channel.title: 1000 Errors: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures
channel.description: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Seed of Life LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Birch Mandala
item.description: Seed of Life light sculpture glowing in rainbow colours on a shop wall. Seed of Life sacred geometry light sculpture, laser cut from layered birch and hand painted, with adjustable LED lighting. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Septagram LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Wood Mandala
item.description: Septagram seven pointed star wooden sculpture held up, unlit, showing the layered gold design. Seven-pointed septagram light sculpture in 7 layers of laser cut wood, LED-lit, with a stand and wall hanging ring. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Laser Cut Eurorack Case Design
item.description: A standalone, parametric app for designing curved Eurorack cases for modular synthesizers, with native exports for CNC and laser cutting. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Squircles: 3D Printed Shadow Lamp Design
item.description: Squircles, a standalone app for designing 3D printed lamps that cast patterned shadows, which began as a Blender add-on. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Layered Laser Cut Beetle Art
item.description: Building an app to add three-dimensional depth to beetle paintings with stacked, laser cut layers of card. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Laser Cut Light Art
item.description: Close-up of layered hexagonal laser cut wall art lit with warm LEDs. Sacred geometry light art, laser cut from layered wood and illuminated with LEDs. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.
